messages:
maya (design): Quick sync — prototype attached. Trying a compact "roles tile" for newcomers instead of the full matrix. Goal: lower friction on first invite and reduce cognitive load. Screenshot + interaction notes below.
liam (pm): Nice. Curious how this plays with bulk-invite flows. Is the tile just a shortcut, or the canonical way to set role for single invites?
samir (frontend): It should be a shortcut that opens the full matrix if they need more granularity. Implementation idea: tile is a 1-row quick-set, click expands to modal with matrix.
maya (design): Exactly. Quick-set options: Viewer, Editor, Admin + tooltip. If they need multiple role assignments, show the big matrix. Also adding a small "Why roles matter" microcopy for first-time org admins.
elaine (a11y): Two quick notes: 1) the tile needs a clear focus ring and ARIA label, e.g., `role="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="rolesModal"` so screen readers announce expansion. 2) color contrast on the selected state is borderline — use 4.5:1 at least.
samir (frontend): Good call. I'll wire `aria-expanded` and ensure keyboard opens via Enter/Space. For colors, proposal: swap current teal (#2db7b7) with #107070 for selected state, should bump contrast.
liam (pm): On the invite flow copy: current modal header says "Invite people" — can we test "Add team members"? Feels warmer for customers. Also want to include SSO enforcement hint for orgs with SSO enabled.
maya (design): Suggestion: header = "Add team members" and subheader: "They'll get an email to join {org}". SSO hint as a badge: "SSO enforced — members must sign in with {idp}" with a tooltip for admins.
elaine (a11y): Tooltips must be accessible: `role="tooltip" aria-describedby` pattern, keyboard focusable trigger. Also ensure the SSO badge has an accessible name e.g., "Single Sign-On enforced for this organization".
samir (frontend): For the SSO confirm flow: current pattern uses a big modal that disrupts flow. Proposal: inline confirmation row in the invite drawer: small lock icon + "Members will sign in with SSO" and two links: "Manage SSO" and "Continue". Less friction.
liam (pm): Hmm, product question: if SSO is required, do we block invites for external emails? We need to clarify policy language. For now, show a warning: "Invited emails may be required to use SSO. Check policy."
maya (design): Copy proposals: short warning line in yellow: "This org requires SSO for sign-in. Invited users must accept via SSO." CTA link: "Review SSO settings".
elaine (a11y): Yellow warnings are tricky — ensure icon + text and contrast. Also add role="alert" when the warning appears so assistive tech is notified for dynamic content.
infra-bot: deploy-preview available at https://staging.redwood.tools/roles-tile/2320 — build #4987, includes keyboard nav and aria props.
samir (frontend): Tested the preview. A couple of bugs: 1) focus trap in modal not released when closing via Esc sometimes. 2) NVDA reads duplication of "Add team members" when entering modal — likely heading + aria-label repetition.
maya (design): Thanks — will update DOM structure to avoid duplicate accessible names. For modal title maybe visually present but `aria-hidden="true"` on duplicate label.
liam (pm): Audit log nav concern: when someone wants to see who changed a role, current path is Settings > Audit log > filters. Suggest introducing a "Recent role changes" quick-link on the roles page that opens audit log pre-filtered. Cuts 3 clicks.
samir (frontend): Pre-filter link could be `audit?filter=role_change&actor=&since=30d` — I'll prototype. Need to ensure permissions guard so non-admins don't get dead links.
elaine (a11y): Pre-filtered landing must restore keyboard focus to the top of results and set `aria-live="polite"` when filters apply. Also ensure result rows have accessible names that combine actor + action + timestamp.
maya (design): Visual treatment: small inline chip in roles header: "View recent role changes" with icon. On hover show a micro sandbox of last 3 events.
liam (pm): Love the micro-sandbox idea. Keep it read-only and not show PII (mask emails) by default.
samir (frontend): FYI — masking can be `user.email ? maskEmail(user.email) : "(unavailable)"`. We'll show full email only to org owners in audit UI.
elaine (a11y): Masking is fine as long as screen readers can reveal via an explicit control. e.g., a "Show details" button that toggles `aria-hidden`.
maya (design): Final asks for this iteration: 1) roles tile prototype in drawer, 2) SSO inline confirmation with accessible tooltip, 3) quick-link to pre-filtered audit log + micro-sandbox. I'll update the Figma and push assets.
liam (pm): Timelines? Would be great to have a QAable branch by EOD Friday. Samir, you good with that?
samir (frontend): Aiming for Friday. If a11y fixes take longer, prioritize keyboard + screen reader flows and the color contrast.
elaine (a11y): I'll run a quick NVDA pass when samir flags the branch. Also will prepare a short checklist for the audit link and tooltip behaviors.
maya (design): Thanks team. I'll also add two copy variants for a small A/B: "Add team members" vs "Invite teammates" to measure completion on first invite.
liam (pm): Great — post results in this thread. :thumbsup:
